messages.subject: Remaining strict config and run horizon/save cadence gaps
messages.body: Ready config still accepts ignored intent: training.save_every is never read by train_volume (only final checkpoint); regions.detached=False is normalized but manager always detaches; temporal.window arbitrary strings pass shallow validator; geometry.resampling native_z accepts non-null spacing then loader resamples unconditionally. Also --steps2 overrides config horizon4 BEFORE scheduler construction, so a 2+resume-to4 CLI run cannot match an uninterrupted cosine4 run; preservation of the now-shorter horizon is not interruption equivalence. Please implement declared save cadence/intermediate checkpoints or reject unsupported cadence, distinguish planned scheduler horizon from bounded stop target, and tighten unsupported combinations (supervised+active U auxiliaries, ignored mode flags).
